description: List your webhook subscriptions that carry agreement.* events: url, event types, status, last rotation, and previousSignatureUntil while a rotation grace period is open (deliveries then carry a v1 signature with the old and the new secret). Never returns a secret, hash or prefix. Rotating a secret is not available over MCP: use the REST API or the CLI (opentrain agreements webhooks rotate). Requires agreements:read. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).
name: opentrain_agreements_webhooks_list
